findings.title: Request payload typed `any` where the sibling handlers type theirs with a named interface
findings.description: users.ts and orders.ts each declare a payload interface (UserPayload, OrderPayload) and read req.body through it. refunds.ts types the same kind of value `any`, so orderId and amountCents are unchecked. Declare RefundPayload { orderId: string; amountCents: number } and use it.
